agents.definition: Frozen 18 development agent tasks with unchanged effect/policy simulator; all tools isolated; not a new holdout.

coding.definition: HumanEvalPlus frozen 164; base AND plus; HumanEval/32 known invalid retained as failure (163 subset is separate).

mbpp.definition: MBPP+ v0.2.0 original-test release pool: 223/224 tasks admitted before new model outputs; Mbpp/255 official canonical solution exceeds sandbox memory and is separately DEFERRED. Original32 + disjoint191, one answer per task, base AND plus. Not full224 or full378 leaderboard; separate from HumanEval and no proof of training exclusion.

tools.definition: Frozen balanced native-tool subset: 100 cases, 20 in each of five categories; official AST plus irrelevance rules; not full BFCL leaderboard.

rules: No combined score. Counts are one observed answer per task unless repeated cycles are explicitly stated.

Whole configurations: model, tokenizer, native template, output budget, sampling, quantization and engine can differ. Task/scorer matching permits comparison of these profiles, not causal architecture claims.
GPU board energy includes failed task attempts; excludes load/warmup and CPU/system energy. Latency is measured request/case time; startup and judge time are excluded.
NOT MEASURED means no full comparable audited result in this cohort. Partial screens are not converted into full-suite scores.
